# Python oracle: scanner.py configure_tpu and docs/SCANNER_INTERNALS.md.
# Format: operation name, command bytes, payload length.
gamma_r command=1e 84 header=03 00 fc 1f 02 00 01 00 data_len=256
gamma_g command=1e 84 header=03 00 fd 1f 02 00 01 00 data_len=256
gamma_b command=1e 84 header=03 00 fe 1f 02 00 01 00 data_len=256
tpu_mode command=1e a2 data=02
calibration_flag command=1e 25 data=02
timing command=1e 5a data=00 00 00 00
scan_pass command=1e 11 data=03
gain_offset command=1e 31 data_len=12
ccd_config command=1e 21 data_len=26
gain_shading command=1e 84 header=07 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 data_len=256
secondary_ccd command=1e 22 data_len=12
afe command=1e 41 data_len=22
afe_zero command=1e 42 data_len=24
afe_gains command=1e 43 data_len=18
scan_start_config command=1e 01 data_len=12
trigger_calibration command=1e 05 data_len=0
